mechanism: Completed hourly close breaking the preceding 24-hour high/low may continue because adjustment of information and positions is gradual; sideways reversals and costs can refute it.
research_exchange: Binance USD-M provisional; execution venue unconfirmed
dynamic_multiplier: clip(realized_vol_168h/realized_vol_24h, 0.25, 1); entry sizing only in first slice, no intra-position resizing or risk increase
fixed_multiplier_calibration: Unweighted mean dynamic multiplier on all baseline breakout signal rows in training only, pooled BTC/ETH. Overlapping signals remain calibration observations, never independent outcomes.

parent_changes.volatility: baseline entry size times dynamic multiplier
parent_changes.fixed: baseline entry size times training calibrated fixed multiplier

wallet_assumption: Research default because unique actual account configuration unconfirmed; no credentials or account read
cost_model: Native fee 0.0008 combines conservative taker fee 6bp plus 2bp cash slippage allowance; fills remain native OHLC. Actual spread/impact unknown; no claim of order-book simulation.
stress: Conditional same-fill arithmetic extra 4bp/side only; not a separate account backtest or independent sample
funding: Exact source event_time/rate/settlement mark. Positions immediately before event pay/receive; event precedes any fill with identical timestamp. Never zero-fill missing settlement records.
timing: Price source conservatively available close+60s. Strategy shifts entry/exit vector an extra candle and native shifts once, so source candle t first trades at t+2h. Stake reads second-last analyzed candle. Native 1h stop/exit ordering retained; intrahour path unknown.
specifications: Current public exchange filters; historical rules not point-in-time verified, no claim of deployable historical exactness
event_diagnostic: For each baseline breakout row, use causal entry t+2h open and fixed t+26h open exit (24h label), taker+slippage 8bp each side and actual funding events. Only fully matured labels; overlapping events are descriptive, not wallet returns. Compare persistence-pass/fail and high/low volatility-risk multiplier; no optimization.
next_rule: If gross unsupported stop this implementation; if gross positive but net weak prioritize one turnover/holding-scale diagnostic; if factor weak remove factor; if candidate supported freeze and collect true forward confirmation. No optimization based on confirmation.
